figurative_meaning_en: a very minute amount; not even a hair's breadth; the slightest trace
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের মতামতের মধ্যে একচুল তফাত নেই।
এই দুটি ছবির মধ্যে একচুলের বিস্তার আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There isn't a hair's difference between their opinions.
There's only a hair's breadth difference between these two pictures.
note: This idiom draws from everyday imagery of hair's fineness to denote minimal differences, common in Bengali oral tradition.
